flora: Ribbed stem joint (close-up of a thick hollow node, showing an organic tooth-like black-tipped sheath)
Lateral branch whorl (a cluster of slender, segmented green shoots radiating from a nodal ring)
Spore-bearing strobilus (terminal cone showing a distinct, geometric honeycomb scale pattern)
Anatomical stem cross-section (showing an organized ring of hollow vascular chambers and pith)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; structural and chunky; avoid perfectly smooth tubes or manufactured plumbing textures; plant tissues must look fibrous, fleshy, and organic; soft-touch volume.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant layout: Top-Left: a macro focus on a thick ribbed stem joint with its jagged sheath ring; Top-Right: a radiating spray of segmented lateral branches; Bottom-Left: a hero shot of a terminal spore cone; Bottom-Right: a clean anatomical cross-section showing internal hollow chambers.
visual_logic.ground: A flat, clean surface of dark ash gray siltstone, creating a neutral backdrop that highlights the green specimens.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, even diffused daylight to bring out the micro-textures of the ribbing and internal chambers cleanly.
